Which is a water-borne disease (answer: typhoid). Taught: typhoid spreads through contaminated food and water (lebo107/hesc102 Table 2.1); the other options are separated by transmission route in transmission_prevention.
Carrier of malaria (answer: Anopheles mosquito). Taught: female Anopheles carries Plasmodium and is the vector (lebo107; hesc102).
Which mosquito spreads dengue (answer: Aedes). Taught: female Aedes mosquito acts as carrier of dengue virus (hesc102); also lebo107 on Aedes-borne dengue/chikungunya.
